summary: BeforeUpdate handler comparisons emitted as CustomPredicate, not Range.
fix_proposed: Parse VBA AST binary comparisons into Range rules.
rationale: Verifier-suggested fix is semantically inverted: `If <cond> Then Cancel = True` is the rejection predicate, so direct Range parsing would describe the rejected window not the valid one. Compound `>=...And...<=` guards negate to a disjunction (`<` Or `>`) that cannot fit a single ValidationRangeConstraint. Tiebreaker verifier (sonnet) confirmed: 'orchestrator-right; recommended action: none — keep ClassifyBeforeUpdateCondition as is'. The verbatim Expression slot preserves all information for downstream negation-aware extraction if needed.
